title: justicia tigrina
intro: Justicia tigrina, commonly known as Tiger's Jaw, is a plant species in the Acanthaceae family, native to tropical regions of Asia and Africa. The health benefits of Justicia tigrina include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of the plant include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antihypertensive effects, which may help alleviate symptoms of various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Justicia tigrina include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
